title: 第15章 多股势力把目标锁定江海市第16章 最近江海市可能不平静
content_zh:
朗岳一听，感觉大事不好，这个师弟又要发什么疯了。
他刚站起来，杜威就闯了进来。
“师弟，你来了，辛苦了。”
杜威看着朗岳师兄一脸善意并没有给他好脸色，而是指着朗岳怒道：“朗岳师兄，你告诉我，我干儿子到底怎么回事？今天你要不给我一个满意的交代，休怪我翻脸无情！”
朗岳赶忙给杜威倒茶，语气平和：“师弟，先坐下说话。景言的事你听我慢慢说。”
杜威很不耐烦地说道：“有屁就放，你千万不要隐瞒我什么？”
朗岳犹豫了一下后，缓缓说道：“师弟，你应该推演出来了，景言可没我们想象的那么简单。三年前他要去天机山，我已经穷尽一切办法阻拦他，可你也知道，不要说是我，就是我们师兄弟联手也拦不住他。”
朗岳继续说道：“师弟，其实景言是知道去往天机山的后果，可他还是一意孤行，去了。有传闻，他在天机山窥破天机，遭遇天罚，九重雷劫加身，肉身湮灭，景言没了，这三年来，我痛彻心扉......”
“你还知道痛。”杜威打断朗岳的话，拿出手机给他看。
朗岳接过手机，看到屏幕上的陈景言，惊得目瞪口呆。
“师弟，景言没有死？”
“死你的头。你这个狗东西，当年你怎么不去找他，不知道这三年他经历了什么。”
朗岳解释：“师弟，我带人找了几个月，什么都没有发现。天机山我们又上不去，你说我怎么办。”
杜威冷哼一声，眼底闪过一丝痛色：“你当然不行了，不过，我们现在要做的是尽快找到我的干儿子杜晨。”
朗岳对他的大弟子说：“立即召集宗门力量，前往江海市，迎回圣子。”
江海市。
陈景言离开柳家，先去银行itm机上查了何家给他的银行卡，里面竟然有两个亿的余额。
何家真是财大气粗，一出手就是两个亿。
接下来他就去买了一台笔记本电脑，最后去交易所开通了股票、期货交易账户。
这是投资天才华文悦的毕生绝学。

他现在是陈景言这个傻子的身体，华文悦的智慧灵魂，两者的结合堪称完美。
他要以金融为刃，在资本的浪潮中斩出一条通天之路。
在证券交易所，陈景言选择了几只股票，全仓买入，身上只有在街上诊病赚来的一万多块钱。
时间还早，陈景言在街上游荡，很多地方他似曾相识，却又恍如隔世。
他搞不清楚了，这个叫陈景言的躯壳到底是什么人？记忆如潮水般涌来，却又支离破碎。
他最后想去天悦集团看看。
那是宿主华文悦的公司。
天悦集团大厦依旧巍峨，玻璃幕墙倒映着午后阳光。
陈景言来到公司门口，保安拦住了他，不让他进去。
这几个保安他都认识，过去他是天悦集团的董事长，一进公司，他们都要对他毕恭毕敬，现在换了一副皮囊，他们已经不认识他了。
陈景言没有争辩，只是静静地望着大厦顶端那扇熟悉的窗户。
content_en:
When Lang Yue heard this, he felt that something bad was going on, and this junior brother was going crazy again.
As soon as he stood up, Dewey burst in.
"Junior brother, you are here, thank you for your hard work."
Dewey looked at Senior Brother Lang Yue's kind face and did not give him a good look. Instead, he pointed at Lang Yue and said angrily: "Senior Brother Lang Yue, tell me, what happened to my godson? If you don't give me a satisfactory explanation today, don't blame me for being ruthless!"
Lang Yue hurriedly poured tea for Dewey and said in a calm tone: "Junior brother, sit down and talk first. Please listen to me and explain Jing Yan's matter slowly."
Dewey said impatiently: "If you fart, let it go. Don't you hide anything from me?"
After Lang Yue hesitated for a moment, he said slowly: "Junior brother, you must have deduced that Jing Yan is not as simple as we thought. Three years ago, he wanted to go to Tianji Mountain. I have tried every means to stop him, but you also know, not to mention me, even our junior brothers can't stop him together."
Lang Yue continued: "Junior brother, in fact, Jing Yan knew the consequences of going to Tianji Mountain, but he still insisted on going his own way. There are rumors that he spied on the secret of heaven in Tianji Mountain, and suffered a punishment from heaven. The ninth level of thunder disaster was added to his body, his body was annihilated, and Jing Yan was gone. In the past three years, I have been heartbroken..."
"You still know the pain." Dewey interrupted Lang Yue and took out his phone to show him.
Lang Yue took the phone and was stunned when he saw Chen Jingyan on the screen.
"Junior brother, Jing Yan is not dead?"
"Damn your head. You piece of shit, why didn't you go find him back then? I don't know what he has been through in the past three years."
Lang Yue explained: "Junior brother, I led people to search for several months, but found nothing. We can't climb Tianji Mountain, what do you think I should do?"
Dewey snorted coldly, with a flash of pain in his eyes: "Of course you can't survive, but what we need to do now is to find my godson Du Chen as soon as possible."
Lang Yue said to his eldest disciple: "Immediately summon the strength of the sect to go to Jianghai City to welcome back the Holy Son."
Jianghai City.
Chen Jingyan left the Liu family and went to the bank ITM to check the bank card given to him by the He family. There was a balance of 200 million in it.
The He family is really wealthy, with one purchase worth 200 million.
Next he bought a laptop, and finally went to the exchange to open a stock and futures trading account.
This is the lifelong secret of investment genius Wen Yue.
He is now the body of Chen Jingyan, a fool, and the wise soul of Hua Wenyue. The combination of the two is perfect.
He wants to use finance as his blade to carve a path to the sky in the wave of capital.
On the stock exchange, Chen Jingyan selected a few stocks and bought them all. He only had more than 10,000 yuan earned from treating patients on the street.
It was still early, and Chen Jingyan was wandering on the street. Many places seemed familiar to him, but it felt like he was a lifetime away.
He couldn't figure out who this body named Chen Jingyan was? Memories come in like a flood, but they are fragmented.
He finally wanted to visit Tianyue Group.
That is the company of the host Hua Wenyue.
The Tianyue Group Building is still majestic, with its glass curtain walls reflecting the afternoon sun.
When Chen Jingyan came to the door of the company, the security guard stopped him and refused to let him in.
He knew all these security guards. In the past, he was the chairman of Tianyue Group. As soon as he entered the company, they all treated him with respect. But now that he has changed his appearance, they no longer recognize him.
Chen Jingyan did not argue, but quietly looked at the familiar window at the top of the building.
